messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency spike on streaming endpoint /v1/generate detected. p95=420ms p99=2450ms. Affected region: us-west-2. Customers with high streaming usage reporting stalls.

maria-sre: seeing the same on dashboards — tail latency up ~6x last 15m. Error budget at risk for a couple of tenants.

sam-runtime: paging observed on hosts serving prefix-cache. I can repro a drop in cache hit rate for prefix hashing v3 rollout groups.

kevin-platform: confirmed: cache hit from our metrics: 92% -> 28% for prefix namespace shard-9. Frequency of cold-prefetch spikes spiked at 14:03 UTC.

maria-sre: any recent deploys?

sam-runtime: we rolled prefixhash v3 across 20% of capacity at 13:50, and toggled prefetch caching heuristic. rolling back now would be my first mitigation.

jessica-oncall: I'm taking oncall. tagging me @jessica-oncall. I will coordinate with support.

support-lead: customer support: two enterprise customers flagged visible streaming stalls and one support ticket referenced customer-side timeouts. We flagged as P1.

maria-sre: immediate plan: 1) revert prefixhash v3 rollout to 0% for affected pools (manual toggle). 2) Kick cache warmup job for hot prefixes. 3) Enable fallback to prefetch-disabled runtime for heavy streams. Which is fastest?

sam-runtime: rollback toggle is the fastest. Command: 
```
# toggle rollout group 42 -> 0
curl -XPOST "https://controlplane/api/rollouts/42/toggle" -d '{"pct":0}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $CP_TOKEN'
```
I can run that if someone holds the handoff.

kevin-platform: if we toggle, expect a short blip during re-routing (~30-90s) but should recover hit rate towards baseline. Warmup job will take longer but helps p99 within ~5-10m.

jessica-oncall: sam, please run toggle. I will tell support to notify affected customers about mitigation started.

sam-runtime: running toggle now.

incident-bot: Action taken: rollout 42 -> 0% requested by sam-runtime at 1750000051.

sam-runtime: done — controlplane responded OK. Routing changed, rebalancing in progress.

maria-sre: checking metrics... cache hit rate for shard-9 up to 61% after 90s, p99 down to 980ms. Good initial improvement.

support-lead: messaging customers: "We identified a cache-prefetch regression after a recent rollout. We rolled back the rollout and are monitoring; we expect steady improvement over next 10-15 minutes. Apologies for the disruption." ok to send? :+1:

jessica-oncall: send it. Also open an RCA ticket and add tags: prefixhash, prefetch, p99, customer-impact.

maria-sre: follow-up tasks: - postmortem to include rollout gating checks and preflight for hit-rate delta > 10%. - add automatic rollback if p99 > 1500ms for > 3m in canary.

kevin-platform: we should add a synthetic warmup pipeline to prefill new prefix variants before rollout. Note: current rollout assumed opportunistic warmup; that failed for rare long-tail prefixes.

jessica-oncall: handoff notes for next shift:
- what happened: prefixhash v3 rollout created a mismatch in prefix-to-shard mapping causing low local cache hit rate and increased paging.
- mitigation done: rollout rolled back to 0%, warmup jobs queued, fallback route enabled.
- current status: p95 ~ 350ms, p99 ~ 700ms and trending down; cache hit rate 78% global, shard-9 74%.
- affected customers: enterprise-a (ticket #23788), enterprise-b (ticket #23791).
- next steps: RCA owner = sam-runtime, due EOD; implement automatic canary rollback guard, add prefill job and update runbook.

support-lead: added notes to tickets and created Postmortem draft at https://confluence.redwood/products/incidents/PR-1749999999 (link).

maria-sre: tagging followups in backlog. If p99 jumps again, escalate to eng-leads. For now, leaving open until warmup completes in 20m.

jessica-oncall: handing off to night oncall @derek. Please pick up the thread if any regression. Closing live bridge in 10m unless we see re-emergence. :white_check_mark:
